assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness.
The symptoms raise concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The symptoms raise concern for underlying atrial fibrillation.
The applicable diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I47.1.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered.
The mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring service is CPT 93229.
The monitoring is ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management.
